page.layout: One column of italic verse on the page; a marginal note at the right, beside the second stanza; catchword at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: Illuc monstra Erebi regnis expulsa subactis Antiquas repetunt sedes, superosque relinquunt. At furor angusta galeae caelatus in ora Post tergum aeratis compressus brachia nodis Arma super sedet, & victricia vincula mordet.

His Narilus gaudens donis (quamquam artis & Nescius) intentos oculos per singula voluit, (vsus Bellaque, fortunasque virum, atque ingentia facta Miratur tacitus, neque honori cedit, at omnes Partitur Cererem in manes, partitur & angues; Quadrupedes angues, multo quos incoquit igne, Et mensis tantum regalibus India ponit. Addit aues, oneratque cadis agrestia vina E Cerere, & pressis palmarum exhausta medullis.

At Ductor (neque enim mentem consistere rerum Cura finit) pelagi vada per stagnantia coeptum Pergere iter parat, & terras referre propinquas Interea ne forte novo Quiqueia [?] tumultu Foedera perrumpat, neu bella occulta tumescant, Compactis turrim trabibus, vinclisque reuinctam Arboreis, texit saxoso in vertice rupis Sublimen ingentem, pontesque insternit, & altas Subicit his fossas, & propugnacula magna Arte locat, munitque aditus dehinc milite complet Qui procul externis venientes finibus hostes Expellat, positoque Indos in foedere seruet Atque hominum edifcat mores habitusque locorum.

page.notes: Marginal note "(vsus" at the right, beside the second stanza, is printed in the margin; the printed reading is kept. "Quiqueia" is uncertain and marked [?]. Two words in the scan are partly illegible: "manes" (the printed tilde is unclear) and "edifcat" as printed. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
